text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard she runs, Rice can't
seem to find a win. Still, she
hasn't given
up on training.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Gotta give credit to Rice. Takes a whole
lotta something to keep
running her heart
out after all those losses.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Makes you wish we could get her a win
somehow...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pardon the intrusion.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Wait, McQueen?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Out of the blue, McQueen shows up to
practice. It feels like it's been
forever since
she left the team.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I saw Rice didn't do so well in her last race.
How's she doing now?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
She's still got the drive, and she's training
like always, but for some
reason she just
can't deliver.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
She's still got the drive, and she's training
like always, but for some
reason she just
can't deliver.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
She's just... missing something. That
something she had when she
raced you
and Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps she's lost sight of a target to
chase.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Which means that if you're able to give her
a new target, she may run
like she once
did.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In other words... I'd best hurry and get
changed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Why else do you think I've come here?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I still have some unfinished business, but I
have a bit more free time
than before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I don't think I can wait any longer
to run with the team again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but before that, I have a favor to ask
you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: McQueen?! And...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I received a sudden invite to come help
out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
McQueen's "favor" was for me to call
Mihono Bourbon over.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for you to return to form.
Hopefully this session
brings you closer to
a win.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Bourbon... You're the best!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now then, just like old times, I want you to
follow right behind
Bourbon and me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Right! Just keep following you and
Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Just to clarify, that does not include in our private lives. Follow within reason, please.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'll chase Rice from behind then!
And when I catch up to her,
I'll yank her
tail!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hweh?!

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text: We'll help out too!

text_block_list.name: Caring Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, then how about we take turns setting
the pace?

text_block_list.name: Sincere Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Okay! Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Rice, seeing your hard work... your
indomitable spirit, is a big
inspiration to us
all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now show us once more—how you left me
and Bourbon in the dust.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Okay. I will!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Team Sirius. A team whose members
continually inspire and push each
other to
be better.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the encouragement of her
teammates, Rice takes to the track
once
more—her second spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hey Trainer, if I win, you'll take us to that
famous amusement park...
right?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Why do you think I've been eating so
much instant ramen?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Why do you think I've been eating so
much instant ramen?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... But you know, I like the other
park too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
As long as you're there, and the team's
there, we can have fun
anywhere. Just
seeing the others smile makes me smile
too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And I want to make them smile today. So
I'm going to give this race
my all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I should get going now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks so tiny compared to the expanse
of turf, but she makes it
hers.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Here's Rice Shower! She makes her move!
She's pushed up into the
lead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even when her will to win seemed faint,
she refused to give up, and
just kept
running.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower isn't giving up the lead! She's
desperately holding on!
And now... she's
done it!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower returns to the winner's circle
in the spring Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And I'm not the only one who's taken
notice.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
After denying so many records, and losing
so many times, she finally
wins, huh.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
How long were you gonna make us wait?!
Congrats, Rice!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Good job! You were great!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooo!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wh-wha—?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The cheers are deafening! The entire
stadium is lavishing Rice Shower
with
praise!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: They... they're happy... They're smiling!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When the whole world seemed to be
dragging her down, she crawled
back up,
one step at a time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She held on. Worked harder than ever.
And now, she's rewarded with
love from
all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep running, forever and ever! I'll run
until the whole world's
smiling!
